source: Six Important findings an earlier multi-reviewer review published on this head (2026-10-30, each probe-confirmed). Kept as DATA for scoring a review run; never given to a reviewer or a verifier.

items.summary: Microsoft.Playwright.Xunit (PageTest base class) is classified xunit but the xUnit scaffold cannot write such a project
items.note: The package name is specific; 'pagetest' + 'xunit' also matches a finding about the xUnit scaffold's missing base class.

items.summary: inferFramework/appendTestMethod probe matches NUnit's [Theory] as well as xUnit's, so an NUnit file reads as xUnit
items.note: Needs [Theory] and NUnit in one finding; [Theory] alone is mentioned by unrelated test findings.

items.summary: findClassBodyRange splices a method into the FIRST class of the file, which is a [CollectionDefinition] marker class when one comes first
items.note: Phrases specific to the splice position; read matchedBy.

items.summary: scaffoldNewSpecFile throws for a new xUnit file because no step supplies collection, fixtureType or usings
items.note: 'usings' alone is generic, so it is paired with another word the defect uses; read matchedBy.

items.summary: detectE2eFrameworkInDir throws ENOENT/ENOTDIR on a non-existent directory or a file path instead of returning null
items.note: Several phrasings: the readdir call, the error codes, or the function named with a does-not-exist wording.

items.summary: headed / slow-mo overrides are inert for the xUnit shape: the Run request carries no framework
